rationale:
The six same-state local numerical cases now pass: kernel_probe, native_o0 and native_reverse_o0 are all_equivalent, with 6/6 vector, position, speed and direction passes, zero speed_false_safe/unsafe, under the user-approved fixed .5 ms transition reference and independent Cholesky residual/backward-error checks. This certifies only fixed-step transition reproduction — not continuous accuracy, independent backend validation, or milestone closure. Native acceleration is unproven: both completed native variants are slower (median_speedup 0.556 and 0.318; reverse_o0 0.318), and every optimized build failed — -O2 native_probe exceeded the preregistered 600 s cap (~754 s charged), -O1 native_o1 timed out at 360 s (~443 s), and native_reverse (-O1, integrated cc1) timed out at 180 s (~183 s). No successful speedup may be claimed, and timeouts do not prove all optimized methods impossible; only O0 compilation finished. Because timed optimizer stopping can change controller response when accelerated, any accelerated artifact needs a distinct version identity and fresh equivalence comparisons — old backend outcomes cannot validate altered response.

Decisive affordable next experiment: one 16 MB scalar reverse-AD native build at a single optimized level under an explicit 900 s task-local cap, no new backend, followed by exactly six same-state equivalence evaluations against the saved production trajectory plus paired wall-clock timings, and the outstanding feedback/position classification on the original and reset pairs.

Precise measured gate (admit only if all hold): (a) the single optimized build completes within 900 s; (b) all six equivalence checks (vector, position, speed, direction) pass as native_o0 did, with zero false_safe/false_unsafe; (c) median speedup ≥ 1.0x, i.e. strictly faster than the current Python path on the six same-state cases. Fail any condition and do not purchase backends or full forecasts.

When to abstain from complete forecasts/backends: while any candidate native variant is unmeasured or slower, or while an altered controller response lacks fresh equivalence, do not spend the six protected backend reservations or buy full forecasts.
